retrieved_evidence.text_excerpt: The group turns their focus to the Reach; the vast Golden Fields to the north. If they decide to continue on, their destination is Mireward. If they decide to turn around, it's a multiday journey back to Mirathorn. The first thing to do is break their camp and head back to the wagon. The trail is damp from the rain and a magical sheen lies everywhere. In the distance to the west another storm appears to be building and there is a constant feeling of an approaching storm.
